subject: Confirmation of Your Hotel Reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], We would like to confirm your hotel reservation at the Ocean View Resort for the dates of June 15th to June 20th. Your booking includes a deluxe room with a sea view. Please note that the check-in time is at 3:00 PM and check-out time is at 11:00 AM. Should you have any special requests or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you to our resort. Best regards, The Ocean View Resort Team
